title: GPU Artifacting & Display Crash
symptom: When launching 3D games, the screen displays green checkerboard artifacts and pink lines, followed by a display freeze and black screen.

expected_output.symptom_summary: Display renders visual checkerboard patterns and crashes to black under 3D graphical workloads.

evidence.text: displays green checkerboard artifacts and pink lines

possible_causes.cause: Defective Video RAM (VRAM) memory modules or solder joint degradation under thermal expansion.
possible_causes.verification: Run a memory-specific GPU diagnostic (such as MATS/MODS or OCCT VRAM test) to detect memory address errors.

possible_causes.cause: Corrupted graphics card driver state triggering Windows TDR (Timeout Detection and Recovery) resets.
possible_causes.verification: Check Event Viewer for nvlddmkm or amdkmdag Event ID 4101 indicating driver timeout.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Perform a clean driver reinstall using Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU) in Windows Safe Mode.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Safely eliminates corrupted registry entries or driver cache before assuming silicon failure.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Lower GPU core and VRAM clock speeds by 100 MHz using vendor utility (e.g. MSI Afterburner).
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Tests whether marginal memory stability can be mitigated at lower frequencies.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Reseat graphics card in PCIe slot and verify PCIe power connectors are firmly latched.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Rules out power delivery instability or slot contact corrosion.
